stem: Find the common domain of the function $n_1(x)=\frac{x^2-4}{x^2-5x+6}$. Tap the values that must be removed from R.

hints.text: Factorise the denominator into two brackets; each bracket gives a zero.
Only zeroes of the denominator are removed; do not use the numerator.
For each bracket set it equal to zero and solve; check the signs.
